name: us-salary
title: US full-time salary (USD/yr, before tax)
description: Annual earnings of full-time US wage and salary workers. 10th-90th percentiles: BLS usual weekly earnings, Q2 2026 (x52). Above ~$250k: IRS W-2 wage brackets (tax year 2020, up to $10M+) as a share of full-time workers, scaled to 2026 wage levels. See scripts/build_us_salary.py.
